prompt: What is the primary DNS suffix used for in a Windows computer’s naming?
options: Combining with the host name to form its full DNS computer name
Replacing its IPv4 subnet mask
Converting every DNS zone into a primary
Selecting a physical switch port
en: The primary suffix supplies the DNS naming context for the host.
ru: Primary suffix host ke liye DNS naming context deta hai.

prompt: Which full name results from host DNS03 and suffix VCPLAB.Com?
options: DNS03.VCPLAB.Com
VCPLAB.Com.DNS03.in-addr.arpa
en: The host label precedes the suffix in the full DNS name.
ru: Full DNS naam mein host label suffix se pehle aata hai.

prompt: Does setting a primary DNS suffix alone join Active Directory?
options: No; domain joining is a separate operation
Yes; every suffix creates a computer account
Yes; WORKGROUP becomes a domain automatically
Only if the suffix is typed in uppercase
en: Naming context and AD membership are different settings.
ru: Naming context aur AD membership alag settings hain.

prompt: Does configuring a suffix alone guarantee a matching DNS record exists?
options: No; registration or record creation must also succeed
Yes; any suffix creates every required record
Yes; DNSSEC automatically publishes an A record
Only if the computer is a virtual machine
en: A computer name setting does not prove server-side DNS data.
ru: Computer name setting server-side DNS data ka proof nahin.

prompt: What can a suffix search configuration help a resolver do?
options: Expand an unqualified short name into candidate DNS names
Create missing records on every authoritative server
Encrypt all DNS query names
Assign the client a new static address
en: Search rules can expand short names; successful resolution still needs appropriate data and DNS access.
ru: Search rules short names expand kar sakte hain; correct data aur DNS access phir bhi chahiye.

prompt: How are primary suffix and DNS server address different?
options: The suffix is naming context; the address selects a resolver
Both are interchangeable forms of the default gateway
Both directly configure a secondary zone
The suffix must always be written as an IPv4 address
en: A suffix is a DNS name component, not a resolver IP.
ru: Suffix DNS naam ka hissa hai, resolver IP nahin.

prompt: Which statement about DNS suffix settings is accurate?
options: Primary suffix, connection-specific suffix and search list are distinct concepts
Every network interface must always have a different primary suffix
The search list is the same object as a secondary zone
A connection-specific suffix is a VMkernel adapter
en: Related naming settings should be inspected separately rather than assumed identical.
ru: Related naming settings alag inspect hon; identical assume na karein.

prompt: Which command displays Windows host, suffix and adapter details for verification?
options: ipconfig /all
diskpart
Get-Volume
format
en: ipconfig /all displays naming and network configuration details.
ru: ipconfig /all naming aur network configuration details dikhata hai.

prompt: Are VCPLAB.Com and vcplab.com different DNS names solely because of capitalization?
options: No; DNS name comparison is case-insensitive
Yes; they always resolve to unrelated zones
Yes; uppercase names require another DNS service
Only reverse names ignore capitalization
en: Capitalization alone does not make distinct DNS names.
ru: Sirf capitalization se DNS names alag nahin ban jate.

prompt: Why use a trailing dot in dns02.vcplab.com. during a focused DNS test?
options: To make the query absolute rather than rely on suffix expansion
To force automatic AD registration
To convert an A lookup into a PTR lookup
To clear every DNS server’s cache
en: The final dot marks an absolute DNS name.
ru: Aakhri dot absolute DNS naam mark karta hai.

prompt: Which guest was the subject of the recorded suffix exercise?
options: DNS03
DNS01’s public DNS forwarder
The default gateway only
An unnamed storage appliance
en: The suffix screenshots and post-restart verification belonged to DNS03.
ru: Suffix screenshots aur post-restart verification DNS03 ki thin.

prompt: Which suffix was entered in the classroom DNS03 exercise?
options: VCPLAB.Com
0.168.192.in-addr.arpa
en: VCPLAB.Com was the recorded primary DNS suffix.
ru: Recorded primary DNS suffix VCPLAB.Com tha.

prompt: Which Server Manager navigation opened DNS03’s computer properties?
options: Local Server → computer-name link
File and Storage Services → disk format
DNS Manager → Zone Transfers
Workstation → Virtual Network Editor
en: The Local Server computer-name link opens the naming properties used in the exercise.
ru: Local Server ka computer-name link exercise ki naming properties kholta hai.

prompt: Which path reached the primary suffix field in the recorded workflow?
options: Computer Name → Change → More
DNS Manager → Conditional Forwarders → New
Ethernet IPv4 → Default gateway
Disk Management → Change drive letter
en: The More dialog in computer-name changes contains the primary suffix setting.
ru: Computer-name changes ka More dialog primary suffix setting rakhta hai.

prompt: Which membership setting was retained while configuring DNS03’s suffix?
options: WORKGROUP
A newly joined VCPLAB.Com AD domain
A forest trust to KRNC.org
A VMware storage cluster
en: The recorded suffix change did not join an AD domain.
ru: Recorded suffix change AD domain join nahin tha.

prompt: The naming dialog requests a restart. What completes the recorded application/verification sequence?
options: Restart DNS03, sign in and inspect ipconfig /all
Restart the router and assume the guest changed
Delete the forward zone before signing out
Change every lab server’s IP address
en: The recorded workflow applied the change after the guest restart and checked the result.
ru: Recorded workflow mein guest restart ke baad result check hua.

prompt: Which post-restart combination matches the recorded DNS03 naming result?
options: Host Name DNS03; Primary DNS Suffix VCPLAB.Com
Host Name VCPLAB.Com; Primary DNS Suffix 192.168.0.123
Host Name DNS01; Primary DNS Suffix WORKGROUP
Host Name 255.255.255.0; Primary DNS Suffix DNS03
en: The host label and suffix remained separate fields with the expected values.
ru: Host label aur suffix alag fields mein expected values ke saath thay.

prompt: DNS03’s preferred DNS is .123 and alternate is .121. What does the suffix procedure do to those recorded values?
options: It does not inherently change resolver IP settings
It automatically replaces them with the suffix text
It deletes the alternate DNS setting
It converts .121 into the default gateway
en: Computer naming and adapter resolver addresses are separate configurations.
ru: Computer naming aur adapter resolver addresses alag configurations hain.

prompt: Search rules include VCPLAB.Com. Which candidate may be formed from the short name dns02?
options: dns02.vcplab.com
dns02.in-addr.arpa by default
en: Suffix expansion can form that candidate, though exact behavior depends on resolver settings and the application.
ru: Suffix expansion yeh candidate bana sakti hai; exact behavior resolver settings aur application par depend karta hai.

prompt: The suffix is verified on DNS03. What can be inferred about DNS02’s suffix?
options: Nothing definitive without separate DNS02 evidence
DNS02 must have the identical suffix already
DNS02 automatically changes whenever DNS03 restarts
DNS02 becomes a domain controller
en: Evidence from one computer does not establish another computer’s setting.
ru: Aik computer ki evidence doosray computer ki setting establish nahin karti.

prompt: A domain-controller contact error appears during a suffix-only exercise. What is a useful check?
options: Whether Domain membership was selected instead of retaining WORKGROUP and using More
Whether every A record is uppercase
Whether the storage disk is split into files
Whether the desktop has a wallpaper
en: Selecting domain join changes the operation and can require contacting a domain controller.
ru: Domain join select karne se operation badalta aur domain controller contact chahiye ho sakta hai.

prompt: The primary suffix is still blank after a change was attempted. What should be checked?
options: The saved More-dialog entry and whether the required restart completed
Only the remote zone’s MX records
Only the physical Ethernet cable color
The spelling of the VMware datastore label
en: Verify that the local setting was applied before diagnosing remote DNS records.
ru: Remote DNS records diagnose karne se pehle local setting apply hona verify karein.

prompt: The absolute name dns02.vcplab.com. resolves but the short name dns02 does not. Which area is most relevant?
options: The client/application’s suffix-search behavior
Automatically assume the full host record is missing
Recreate every reverse zone immediately
Promote the secondary without further checks
en: Working absolute-name resolution narrows attention to short-name expansion and resolution paths.
ru: Absolute naam resolve ho to short-name expansion aur resolution path par tawajjuh jati hai.

prompt: DNS03.VCPLAB.Com appears in computer properties, but DNS queries return NXDOMAIN. What is a valid next investigation?
options: Check the selected DNS server and whether its zone contains the required record
Assume the displayed computer name proves the DNS record exists
Replace the subnet mask with VCPLAB.Com
Delete the primary suffix immediately without inspecting DNS
en: Local identity is not proof of registration or a matching record on the queried server.
ru: Local identity queried server par registration ya matching record ka proof nahin.

prompt: Someone claims a successful suffix change proves DNSSEC validation. What is the correct response?
options: Suffix configuration and DNSSEC validation are different tasks
The claim is true whenever the suffix ends in .com
A suffix is automatically a DNSKEY trust anchor
Restarting the guest validates every signed zone
en: Naming context does not establish signatures, trust anchors or validation behavior.
ru: Naming context signatures, trust anchors ya validation behavior establish nahin karta.
